hero.headlineLine1: We are not the hands that write code,
hero.headlineLine2: but the mind that knows what to write.
hero.sub: We build internal management systems, process automation and AI solutions for factories, warehouses, logistics, construction and retail businesses in Uzbekistan.
hero.trust: 12 delivered projects · Manufacturing · Construction · Finance · Healthcare · Education

problem.title: If any of this sounds familiar — let's talk

items.pain: You don't know where you lose customers
Stock figures are wrong, goods go missing
Every report takes three days; decisions are made blind
The same number is different in three places
The process is undefined — everyone does it their own way
Nobody knows what for — a competitor has it

problem.closing: We don't build what's requested. We find what's actually wrong.

items.title: We study the business before we write code
items.body: Every project starts with Discovery — a paid, standalone stage. We don't take a spec from the client; we write it.
items.proof: PROOF — the Discovery report: usable even without us

items.title: A solution shaped to you
items.body: We fit the system to the business, not the business to the system. Off-the-shelf ERP forces you to break your process — we do the opposite.
items.proof: PROOF — the system uses your terms and your report formats

items.title: AI as an outcome, not decoration
items.body: Every AI component solves a named pain and its result is measured. If a plain rule is enough, we don't use AI.
items.proof: PROOF — an accuracy metric and a monthly cost figure per component

items.title: Engineering quality
items.body: Readable, documented, tested code. The system stays maintainable in three years — even by a different team.
items.proof: PROOF — the code and docs are yours, handed over together

items.title: You hear bad news from us first
items.body: If a deadline slips or an approach fails, you hear it from us before you notice it.
items.proof: PROOF — a weekly status report and a same-day heads-up

rows.free: The client doesn't take it seriously
rows.paid: The client commits time and people

steps: Business analysis — how the business makes money
Process analysis — how the work actually happens

blockB.caption: The goal is to find the right problem, not to pitch a solution.

blockC.callout: If we go ahead, the analysis is effectively free — the Discovery fee is fully credited against the project price. If we don't, the report is yours to take to anyone.
blockC.finePrint: Applies when the contract is signed within 30 days and the project is at least 5× the Discovery fee.

blockD.rhythm: Weekly — a written status report · Every 2 weeks — a working demo · End of each stage — sign-off
blockD.guarantee: Three-month warranty from the handover date.

industries.title: Industries
industries.subline: What they share isn't the industry — it's the process.

work.title: Work

bekuz.solution: One order carries several receive and pay legs; transactions auto-pair to legs
An immutable rate snapshot per leg — value, source, timestamp
Margin recalculation runs without mutating history
Balances are never stored — always derived from the ledger
Per-module permissions, own/all data scope, append-only audit log
Web, mobile, WhatsApp and a Telegram AI agent over one data set

work.note: Measurable results per project are shared separately, with the client's consent. Only verified numbers go into a proposal.

fit.title: Who we're for
good: Processes run on paper or Excel
Knows the problem, not the solution
bad: A modern ERP is already in place
Arrives with a finished spec looking for hands
fit.closing: When a client says "we need a system like this", we ask "what for?". A client unwilling to answer isn't our client.

items.a: Because free analysis and paid Discovery produce different work. With free analysis the client doesn't take it seriously, there is no real data access, we guess, and the price changes later. With paid Discovery the client commits time and people, access is granted, we know, and the price is fixed.
No. Without Discovery we would be guessing, and the price would change later. After Discovery the price is fixed.
Yes. The code and docs are yours, handed over together, transferred on full payment.

items.q: How long does a project take?
items.a: It depends on the service. Internal management systems take 3–8 months, process automation 1–4, AI solutions and agents 1–5, integration and data 1–3, and websites and web solutions 2–8 weeks.
A three-month warranty from the handover date, then a support contract with an SLA.

finalCta.headline: We start by understanding your problem
finalCta.body: A 30-minute conversation. Not a pitch — questions. We'll understand your business and tell you honestly whether we're a fit.
finalCta.privacy: We don't share your data with third parties.
finalCta.success: Thank you. We'll be in touch shortly.
